questions.question: Is this really a one-time payment? No hidden fees?
questions.answer: Yes. Pay once, use forever. No monthly fees, no annual renewals, no surprise charges. Updates and bug fixes included.

questions.question: What if I need help or support?
questions.answer: First year of support included. Community forum and documentation always free. Extended support available for purchase.

questions.question: Can I try it before buying?
questions.answer: Absolutely. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Export your data anytime if it's not a fit.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Your data is encrypted and backed up daily. Self-hosted option available for full control. We never sell your data.

questions.question: Can I migrate from FreshBooks/QuickBooks?
questions.answer: Yes. Import tools for CSV data from major platforms. Migration guide included. Takes about 15 minutes.

questions.question: Do you offer refunds?
questions.answer: 30-day money-back guarantee. If EZBill isn't saving you money and time, we'll refund you—no questions asked.
